_comment: This file is managed by the todo CLI. Do not edit it directly, by hand or with a script. Read it with todo: `todo next --json` (what to work on), `todo show --id <id|ref> --json` (one task), `todo list --flat` (every item as flat JSON records). Change it with todo commands (add, edit, move, status, assign, rm, ...; see `todo --help`), which keep its ids and rules valid.

tasks.title: Reshape weather widget edit dialog to fit the screen
tasks.description: The Widget Settings dialog for the weather widget is too tall and too narrow: it scrolls vertically with Save/Cancel cut off at the bottom. Make it wider and lay settings out in columns/sections (e.g. location + display | extra info checkboxes in a grid | forecast + graph options) so it fits a typical screen without scrolling.

tasks.title: Refactor widget documentation page (/admin/docs/widgets)
tasks.description: Index page groups widgets by category as cards; each widget gets its own doc page with Overview (live preview + settings toggles) and Details (per-parameter reference) tabs.

subtasks.title: Index page: one section per widget category
subtasks.description: Category title uses the heading level that best fits the page hierarchy (h2/h3...); inside each category a 3-column grid of cards, each showing a simplified widget representation with its name below

subtasks.title: Dedicated page per widget
subtasks.description: Short description of the widget at the top, then a tab view with two tabs: Overview and Details

subtasks.title: Overview tab: live preview + settings
subtasks.description: Left side: rendered widget representation; right side: the widget's settings toggles, changes reflected live in the preview

subtasks.title: Details tab: parameter reference
subtasks.description: Specific description of each widget parameter

tasks.title: PNG preview for image dashboards in /admin/dashboards
tasks.description: The dashboards list has no way to see the rendered image of an image dashboard; even the existing Preview action does not show the image representation. Add a new column/icon, shown only for image dashboards, that opens a PNG preview.

subtasks.title: Preview-as-PNG column/icon in the dashboards list
Thin Vue render-preview view with rendering parameters
subtasks.description: Lets the user pick the e-ink display type, choose between plain PNG render and e-ink simulation, and pick from common e-ink panel sizes/resolutions
